text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi wasn't feeling well, so I had her take a rest in the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Zzz... snore...
Mumble mumble...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I did it...!
It's finally finished~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Tsuyoshi Brand Health Drink #244—
"Ultimate Build-Up
Tsuyoshi Drink DX"!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
An impeccably miraculous, healthy body...!
If I drink this, it should be mine!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's—
*gulp*, *gulp*...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ohh... oohhhhooooohhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, power is welling up within me!
It feels like an aura of sheer dominance overflowing from deep inside...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "I gotta put this power to the test! Here I gooooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Teeryaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*KAAA-RAAAACK!!!!*)

text_block_list.name: Spectator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~~~?! The ball flew clear into the sky...!
What kind of power is that?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Doryaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splaaash!)

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer
text_block_list.text:
What did you say?!
C-Catching a tuna by swimming after it...!
What kind of Umamusume is she?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Amazing...! I don't feel tired at all!
I feel like I can do anything right now!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
My body...
I never knew it could move like this!

Fufu, in that case...
you can compete against us to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Such formidable strength, truly towering spirit...
Well worthy of clashing with everything we have.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your strength... show it to me in that trial of iron wills—
the triathlon.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Swim! Paddle! Run!
Nishi-shi, I won't lose, Tsuru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
A match against the President and Teio-chan...!
Yes, that's just what I want!
I'll take you on with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, let's settle this... wait, huh?!
Where are we...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I see, it was just a dream.
But someday, I'll definitely become like that...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to getting plenty of rest,
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi was back in top form.
